metaDescription: Order custom full color notepads for your brand. Perfect for office giveaways and promotional use. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Full color notepads let you reproduce logos, photos, or detailed graphics with crisp, vibrant results. Unlike one- or two-color imprinting, full color gives you the freedom to use gradients, small text, and complex artwork. This makes them ideal for branded memo books, tear-off scratch pads, or sticky note cubes that double as mini billboards. Whether you need 25-sheet scratch pads for trade shows or 300-sheet Post-it Note cubes for client gifts, full color ensures your message stands out.
